fullContent:
Chandramrit Ras – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Rasamrit 
 Introduction 
 Chandramrit Ras is an Ayurvedic formulation in the form of tablets. It helps in curing asthma, fever, bronchitis, cough etc. It helps in balancing Vata and Kapha. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Saunth (Zingiber officinalis) 
 Black pepper (Piper nigrum) 
 Long pepper (Piper longum) 
 Haritaki (Terminalia chebula) 
 Bibhitaki (Terminalia bellirica) 
 Amalaki (Emblica officinalis) 
 Chavya (Piper chaba) 
 Coriander (Coriandrum sativum) 
 Cumin (Cuminum cyminum) 
 Rock salt 
 Purified Mercury 
 Purified Sulphur 
 Loha Bhasma 
 Purified and processed Mica 
 Borax 
 Malabar nut extract (Adhatoda vasica) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Clean and finely crush all the ingredients to a fine powder with extract of Adhatoda vasica and mix it to form paste like consistency and make pills from it. 
 Dosage 
 375mg twice daily after meals with honey and lotus petals or fresh ginger juice extract or as prescribed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 Indications 
 
 Fever 
 Cough 
 Bronchitis 
 Cold 
 Asthma 
 Epistaxis 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Self-medication might prove to be dangerous. 
 Over dosage is discouraged as it contains severe poisonous effects. 
 It is best avoided during pregnancy, lactation and in children. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
